correctness.rationale: For six-label involution permutation matrices: verified each fixed point/transposition partition yields W(K)=(-1)^(ΣK_ii) Z(t), t_ij=K_ij+K_ji+K_ii+K_jj mod2, surjective 15 bits with fibers 2^21. Independently enumerated all 32768 signed K6 monomer-dimer recurrences (76 matchings), exact 19-level integer spectrum; zeros=6825, nonzero=25943, min nonzero |Z|=4. Independently recounted zero negative-edge supports 5:480,7:2880,9:2280,11:1185; relabeling all 720 permutations yields 26 orbits, with support-five orbit sizes 120 and 360 and claimed degree sequences. Support indicator Walsh absolute sum 1,524,338 gives sharp endpoint norm 762169/16384 and nullity 6825*2^21. No full-n classification asserted. Finite exhaustive enumeration is a complete certificate for fixed n=6; code reviewed, not only a saved success marker.

value.rationale: The six-label involution family is the first sizable natural monomer–dimer group embedding with a nontrivial signed Walsh zero locus.
